title: GAUSS: a 2 ULP witness and an open row waiting on the erf substrate
status_plain: GAUSS is the half of G3-07 that stayed open when PHI was resolved out. Its evidence is one witness -- GAUSS(1), local 0x3fd5d897a241a6fa against Excel 0x3fd5d897a241a6fc, 2 ULP, on build 19929 -- and the diagnosis that it needs the erf/CDF substrate, which is still open. No count exists.

schema_additions: counts[].source_sentence — the verbatim source sentence carrying the figure (mandated: every figure must be traceable to a quoted sentence).
counts[].figure_display_only — const true; makes FOUNDATION §2.5's 'figure is display only, guard G-9' explicit on the datum itself.

counts[].builds / build_ambiguity / arch / cpu / cpu_scoped / excel_bitness / workbook_mode / plumbing — FOUNDATION puts these in a record-level `oracle` object. They are carried PER COUNT here so that no count can inherit an environment from a sibling count in the same record.

counts[].currency — enum current | current-and-only | superseded | pre-repair-baseline | stale-in-source | withdrawn. Answers ATTRIBUTION-CORRECTIONS §2.3 item 2: a superseded figure must be dispositioned 'superseded', not silently absent.
counts[].ambiguity_note — nullable; the published statement of an unresolved source ambiguity attached to this specific figure.

counts[].measurement_subject gains the value 'handbook-recomputation-over-cached-corpus' — a computation over stored bits performed by an agent, NOT a live-Excel oracle run. counts[].build_ambiguity gains the value 'not-stated-in-this-record' for sources that name no Excel build anywhere.

upstream_anchor.cited_text_sha256_basis — 'git-object-at-473efa3' or 'working-tree-untracked-path' (smart-fuzzer/work, smart-fuzzer/cache and .tmp are gitignored in OxFunc, so no object exists at the commit).
